products.product_description:
Details:

MELATONIN TEA (vegetarian of course) with 5mg of Melatonin plus 2,000mg of Chamomile flowers in every tea bag
will make you sleep like a baby and overcome jet lag immediately. A natural sleep starter for PILOTS AND AIRLINE CREW, INTERNATIONAL TRAVELLERS, SHIFT WORKERS, and for those who need to fall asleep quickly, so that they will get enough hours of sleep to wake up fresh for work.

Delicious chamomile flowers infused with Melatonin. Each tea bag contains 5mg of Melatonin and 2,000mg of dried Chamomile flower petals. A wonderful bedtime tea to make you sleep quickly and soundly.
 
No sugar. Zero calories.
 
Chamomile has a calming, relaxing effect. Combined with Melatonin, it is a great natural sleep starter with no side effects. Can be used every night safely as it is non addictive. And tastes great too!
 
Traditionally, chamomile has been used for centuries as an anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, mild astringent and healing medicine. As a traditional medicine, it is used to treat wounds, ulcers, eczema, gout, skin irritations, bruises, burns, canker sores, neuralgia, sciatica, rheumatic pain, hemorrhoids, mastitis and other ailments.
 
Chamomile has been frequently used as a mild sedative to calm nerves and reduce anxiety, to treat hysteria, nightmares, insomnia and other sleep problems.
 
Chamomile has been valued as a digestive relaxant and has been used to treat various gastrointestinal disturbances including flatulence, indigestion, diarrhea, anorexia, motion sickness and nausea.
 
What is melatonin?
 
Melatonin is made by the pineal gland, a small gland in the brain. Melatonin helps control your sleep and wake cycles. Very small amounts of it are found in foods such as meats, grains, fruits, and vegetables.
What does natural melatonin do in the body?
Your body has its own internal clock that controls your natural cycle of sleeping and waking hours. In part, your body clock controls how much melatonin your body makes. Normally, melatonin levels begin to rise in the mid- to late evening, remain high for most of the night, and then drop in the early morning hours.
Natural melatonin levels drop with age. Some older adults make very small amounts of it or none at all. That is why older people sleep less and need to take Melatonin to get good refreshing sleep.
Why is melatonin used as a dietary supplement?
Melatonin is used to treat jet lag or sleep problems (insomnia).

Other uses for melatonin are:
Helping to control sleep patterns for people who work night shifts, travelers, airlines pilots and cabin crew
For people who are stressed or agitated or worried and cannot sleep
For people who are sick with the flu or coughs and need to sleep but cannot
For people who need to get to sleep because they have to get up early the next morning
For people who live in noisy places and so find it hard to fall asleep

Directions: Place one tea bag into a cup. Pour boiling water and let it brew for 5 minutes. Drink about one hour before you go to bed. Take only once a day or once within 24 hours.

products.title: Haddrell's of Cambridge Manuka Honey UMF 10+ 1kg
products.product_description:
The Haddrell’s Story
Haddrell's of Cambridge® is one of the longest standing producers of UMF™ Grade Manuka Honey. It was established in 1993 by Richard and Moira Haddrell with a great passion for honey and fifteen beehives. Cambridge is a small rural town in the centre of the lush dairy farming district of Waikato, in the North Island of New Zealand, ideally located close to the pristine hills where the unique Manuka Tree grows.
Haddrell's of Cambridge® UMF™ certified Manuka honey supports health and wellbeing. We guarantee the UMF™ rating of all our Manuka Honey by independently testing every batch by accredited scientific laboratories in New Zealand.
What is UMF? 
UMF™ is a quality trademark that grade Mānuka honey by measuring its Unique Mānuka Factors (UMF™) and certify it with a UMF™ number (from 5+ to 25+). (Read here for more information of the grading system)
In short, it assures purity and quality. Honey companies that use this grading system are official licensees of the UMF™ Honey Association (UMFHA), which has strict criteria and audits its members’ packaging and marketing material.
Both Nature’s Farm and Haddrell's of Cambridge® are members of the UMFHA
Rating of Manuka Honey:
UMF <10+ For health maintenance
UMF 10 - 14+ Ideal for better immunity and increased energy level
UMF = 15+ Superior levels with very high activity levels for therapeutic usageÂ for example sore throat.
Health Benefits:
Manuka Honey is a premium source of nutrient, and naturally rich in amino acids, vitamins & enzymes.
A higher rating of UMF® indicates a better quality of nutrients.
What is the difference between UMF & MGO?
UMF and MGO are two individual grading systems. UMF™ is a complete and advance grading system that measures:
MGO Levels
Additional testing of authenticity markers such as Leptosperin and Dihydroxyacetone (DHA)
Hydroxymethylfurfural (HMF) – Quality marker to guarantee the honey has not undergone excessive heating.
The MGO Manuka Honey grading system simply and directly reflects the MGO (methylglyoxal) content of the honey. An MGO rating is a standardised measure of methylglyoxal content and is an indicator of quality.
Both UMF and MGO grading systems are precise and reliable tests. However, there have been reported cases where artificial DHA and MGO has been added to increase the anti-bacterial properties.
As such, the UMF grading system is the best indicator for authenticity, purity and quality of Manuka Honey as compared to MGO
Ingredient list: Manuka Honey
Recommended dosage: Take 1 teaspoon 1-3 times daily (Do not feed to infants under 1)
Product of New Zealand

products.title: Haddrell's of Cambridge Manuka Honey UMF® 16+ 500g
products.product_description:
The Haddrell's Story
Haddrell's of Cambridge® is one of the longest standing producers of UMF™ Grade Manuka Honey. It was established in 1993 by Richard and Moira Haddrell with a great passion for honey and fifteen beehives. Cambridge is a small rural town in the centre of the lush dairy farming district of Waikato, in the North Island of New Zealand, ideally located close to the pristine hills where the unique Manuka tree grows.
 
Haddrell's of Cambridge® UMF™ certified Mānuka honey supports health and wellbeing. We guarantee the UMF™ rating of all our Manuka Honey by independently testing every batch by accredited scientific laboratories in New Zealand.

What is UMF? 
UMF™ is a quality trademark that grade Mānuka honey by measuring its Unique Mānuka Factors (UMF™) and certify it with a UMF™ number (from 5+ to 25+). (Read here for more information of the grading system)
In short, it assures purity and quality. 
 
Honey companies that use this grading system are official licensees of the UMF™ Honey Association (UMFHA), which has strict criteria and audits its members’ packaging and marketing material.
Both Nature’s Farm and Haddrell's of Cambridge® are members of the UMFHA

Rating of Manuka Honey 

UMF <10+ For health maintenance
UMF 10 - 14+ Ideal for better immunity and increased energy level
UMF = 15+ Superior levels with very high activity levels for therapeutic usageÂ for example sore throat.

 
Health Benefits

Manuka Honey is a premium source of nutrient, and naturally rich in amino acids, vitamins & enzymes.


A higher rating of UMF® indicates a better quality of nutrients.




What is the difference between UMF & MGO?
UMF and MGO are two individual grading systems  UMF™ is a complete and advance grading system that measures:
 

MGO Levels
Additional testing of authenticity markers such as Leptosperin and Dihydroxyacetone (DHA)
Hydroxymethylfurfural (HMF) – Quality marker to guarantee the honey has not undergone excessive heating. 







The MGO Manuka Honey grading system simply and directly reflects the MGO (methylglyoxal) content of the honey. An MGO rating is a standardised measure of methylglyoxal content and is an indicator of quality.
 
Both UMF and MGO grading systems are precise and reliable tests. However, there have been reported cases where artificial DHA and MGO has been added to increase the anti-bacterial properties.
 
As such, the UMF grading system is the best indicator for authenticity, purity and quality of Manuka Honey as compared to MGO

products.product_description:
Barley Grass Powder Contain:（3g×44sachets / per box )

Yamamoto Kanpoh’s barley grass uses juvenile shoots of barley grass abundant in nutrients.
On the farmland managed by the company, absorbing nutrients from the sun and the earth, the barley grass of "the highest nutritional value" slowly grows up, for 60 days, a period four times longer than usual, and only the first shoots that grow are harvested, only young leaves from the high-quality "first cutting" are used.
Committed to maintain a 100% additive-free product, we do not use any agricultural chemicals or chemical fertilizers. Naturally, flavourings and other chemicals are also not used, to the best of our ability we use safe and secure barley grass that only utilizes “the power of nature”.
The screening of the base ingredients is performed with great care and the sprouts- checked one by one, any plants and foreign bodies other than the barley grass and anything that interferes with the barley’s growth is removed.
Moreover, when importing, the chemical inspections are carried out by an external agency and by our own laboratory, we only use the ingredients that have passed the inspection. Manufacturing is carried out in our own factory in Aichi Prefecture, Japan.
We continuously challenge ourselves in order to improve the taste and quality of our product.

Yamamoto Kanpoh Barley Grass Powder is recommended for people who:
_ Do not eat enough vegetables.
_ Want to drink delicious barley grass juice.
_ Want to maintain good health
_ Do not like vegetables.
_ Want to supplement vegetable intake while on a diet.

 Ingredients
Yamamoto Kanpou Barley Grass Powder is 100% pure barley leaves (leaf) powder. Yamamoto Kanpou Barley Grass Powder is made from young barley leaves grown without the use of pesticides, and contains NO binders, sweeteners, fillers, or additives of any kind.

 DirectionsIn a shaker/glass, mix 3g (2 full scoops/ 1 pack) of Yamamoto Kanpou Barley Grass Powder with 4 oz. of water, milk, soymilk, or juice. Have 1-2 servings daily.

products.title: [6 Bottles] LABO Camelina Oil Bundle Plant Sterol High Smoke Point Cooking Oil Omega 3 Family Value Halal
products.product_description:
LABO Nutrition Camelina Oil offers a nutritious upgrade for everyday meals. Naturally rich in Omega 3-6-9, Vitamin E, and plant sterols, this 100% unrefined, cold-pressed oil preserves vital nutrients. With its delicate flavour and 245°C smoke point, it provides unmatched versatility for salad dressings, dipping bread, stir-frying, baking, and BBQ without sacrificing taste.

Who Is LABO Nutrition Camelina Oil For?
Our Camelina Oil is a great choice if you:
• Want an everyday cooking oil with higher nutritional value
• Want one versatile oil for everyday cooking
• Prefer a delicate, subtle-tasting oil that complements your food
• Want a cooking oil with lower saturated fat

Why Choose LABO Nutrition Camelina Oil For Everyday Cooking
• 245°C High Smoke Point
- Gives you more flexibility for high-heat everyday cooking
• Naturally High in Omega-3
- Contains 38% Omega-3, making it easy to add more plant-based Omega-3 through your meals
• A Better Balance of Healthy Fats
- Provides Omega 3-6-9 with an Omega-3 to Omega-6 ratio of 2:1
• Lower in Saturated Fat
- Contains 25% less saturated fat than regular oil
• 100% Unrefined Cold Pressed
- Extracted without heat or chemical solvents
• Preserve Nutrients, Antioxidants & Natural Flavor
• Highly Stable & Resistant to Rancidity and Oxidation

3rd Party Lab-Verified Quality
How often do you find a cooking oil that is lab-tested with a Certificate of Analysis for every batch? Every batch of LABO Nutrition Camelina Oil is screened for quality, purity and freshness, so you know exactly what you are getting each time.

• Screened Across 30 Quality & Purity Markers
• Lab-Verified 100% Pure Camelina Profile  
• Individually Screened for 20+ Natural Fatty Acids
• Triple-Tested for Peak Freshness
• Triple-Screened Against Spoiling
• Lab-Proven Freshness That Beats Standard Limits 

Ingredient
100% Unrefined Virgin Camelina Oil

Nutrition Highlights Per 15ml
• Total Fat – 13.7g
 • Saturated Fat – 1.2g
 • Polyunsaturated Fat – 7.8g
 • Omega-3 – 5.3g
 • Omega-6 – 2.5g
 • Monounsaturated Fat – 4.4g
 • Omega-9 – 4.3g
 • Trans Fat – 0g
 • Vitamin E – 9.6mg
 • Plant Sterols – 78mg

Vitamin E & Plant Sterols
With 9.6mg Vitamin E per 15ml, our Camelina Oil provides antioxidant support while helping protect the oil from rancidity and harmful free radical formation. It also provides 78mg plant sterols per 15ml, which help support healthy cholesterol and beneficial Omega-3 levels in the body.

High Heat Stability with an Unrefined Process
Our Camelina Oil gives you something many cooking oils do not: a high 245°C smoke point while remaining unrefined. That means you can use it for high-heat cooking without relying on refined oil.

Unrefined Oils
 • Camelina Oil – 245°C
 • Extra Virgin Olive Oil – 160°C
 • Coconut Oil – 177°C
 • Grape Seed Oil – 216°C
 • Flaxseed Oil – 107°C

Refined Oils
 • Canola Oil – 204°C
 • Sunflower Oil – 227°C
 • Peanut Oil – 227°C
 • Palm Oil – 235°C
 • Safflower Oil – 266°C

So while some refined oils may also have high smoke points, our Camelina Oil stands out by combining high-heat cooking performance with an unrefined process.

Lower Saturated Fat for Everyday Meals
When you cook with our Camelina Oil, you can enjoy the same dishes with less saturated fat compared with selected other oils:
• Fried noodles / stir-fry: up to 4.4X lower saturated fat
• Fried rice: up to 4.3X lower saturated fat
• Fried spring rolls: up to 4X lower saturated fat

Product Quality
• Non-GMO
• Pesticide-Free
• Sustainably Cultivated
• Proven Freshness
• Internationally Approved Quality Standards
• Guaranteed 100% Pure Camelina Oil
• No “Old Oil” Smell
• Pure & Chemical-Free
• Trans Fat Free

Country of Origin
Made in Canada

Net Volume
500ml

Frequently Asked Question
What cooking oil is safe for deep frying without toxic fumes? 
Camelina oil has a high smoke point of 245°C, making it highly stable for deep frying. Heating regular oils past their smoke point produces harmful free radicals, but this unrefined oil remains safe and minimizes greasy buildup.

Does unrefined camelina oil change the taste of food? 
No, it features a delicate and subtle flavour that will not alter your dishes. This makes it an excellent all-purpose culinary oil for everything.

How long does cold-pressed camelina oil last? 
It is highly stable and resists rancidity due to its naturally rich Vitamin E content. This built-in antioxidant protects the oil from rapid oxidation, giving it a longer and more stable shelf life than many other unrefined cooking oils when stored in a cool, dry place.

variants.title: 21st Century Melatonin Tea With 5mg Melatonin + 2,000mg Chamomile Per Tea Bag - 24 Tea bags
variants.product_description:
Details:

MELATONIN TEA (vegetarian of course) with 5mg of Melatonin plus 2,000mg of Chamomile flowers in every tea bag
will make you sleep like a baby and overcome jet lag immediately. A natural sleep starter for PILOTS AND AIRLINE CREW, INTERNATIONAL TRAVELLERS, SHIFT WORKERS, and for those who need to fall asleep quickly, so that they will get enough hours of sleep to wake up fresh for work.

Delicious chamomile flowers infused with Melatonin. Each tea bag contains 5mg of Melatonin and 2,000mg of dried Chamomile flower petals. A wonderful bedtime tea to make you sleep quickly and soundly.
 
No sugar. Zero calories.
 
Chamomile has a calming, relaxing effect. Combined with Melatonin, it is a great natural sleep starter with no side effects. Can be used every night safely as it is non addictive. And tastes great too!
 
Traditionally, chamomile has been used for centuries as an anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, mild astringent and healing medicine. As a traditional medicine, it is used to treat wounds, ulcers, eczema, gout, skin irritations, bruises, burns, canker sores, neuralgia, sciatica, rheumatic pain, hemorrhoids, mastitis and other ailments.
 
Chamomile has been frequently used as a mild sedative to calm nerves and reduce anxiety, to treat hysteria, nightmares, insomnia and other sleep problems.
 
Chamomile has been valued as a digestive relaxant and has been used to treat various gastrointestinal disturbances including flatulence, indigestion, diarrhea, anorexia, motion sickness and nausea.
 
What is melatonin?
 
Melatonin is made by the pineal gland, a small gland in the brain. Melatonin helps control your sleep and wake cycles. Very small amounts of it are found in foods such as meats, grains, fruits, and vegetables.
What does natural melatonin do in the body?
Your body has its own internal clock that controls your natural cycle of sleeping and waking hours. In part, your body clock controls how much melatonin your body makes. Normally, melatonin levels begin to rise in the mid- to late evening, remain high for most of the night, and then drop in the early morning hours.
Natural melatonin levels drop with age. Some older adults make very small amounts of it or none at all. That is why older people sleep less and need to take Melatonin to get good refreshing sleep.
Why is melatonin used as a dietary supplement?
Melatonin is used to treat jet lag or sleep problems (insomnia).

Other uses for melatonin are:
Helping to control sleep patterns for people who work night shifts, travelers, airlines pilots and cabin crew
For people who are stressed or agitated or worried and cannot sleep
For people who are sick with the flu or coughs and need to sleep but cannot
For people who need to get to sleep because they have to get up early the next morning
For people who live in noisy places and so find it hard to fall asleep

Directions: Place one tea bag into a cup. Pour boiling water and let it brew for 5 minutes. Drink about one hour before you go to bed. Take only once a day or once within 24 hours.

variants.title: [6 Bottles] LABO Camelina Oil Bundle Plant Sterol High Smoke Point Cooking Oil Omega 3 Family Value Halal
variants.product_description:
LABO Nutrition Camelina Oil offers a nutritious upgrade for everyday meals. Naturally rich in Omega 3-6-9, Vitamin E, and plant sterols, this 100% unrefined, cold-pressed oil preserves vital nutrients. With its delicate flavour and 245°C smoke point, it provides unmatched versatility for salad dressings, dipping bread, stir-frying, baking, and BBQ without sacrificing taste.

Who Is LABO Nutrition Camelina Oil For?
Our Camelina Oil is a great choice if you:
• Want an everyday cooking oil with higher nutritional value
• Want one versatile oil for everyday cooking
• Prefer a delicate, subtle-tasting oil that complements your food
• Want a cooking oil with lower saturated fat

Why Choose LABO Nutrition Camelina Oil For Everyday Cooking
• 245°C High Smoke Point
- Gives you more flexibility for high-heat everyday cooking
• Naturally High in Omega-3
- Contains 38% Omega-3, making it easy to add more plant-based Omega-3 through your meals
• A Better Balance of Healthy Fats
- Provides Omega 3-6-9 with an Omega-3 to Omega-6 ratio of 2:1
• Lower in Saturated Fat
- Contains 25% less saturated fat than regular oil
• 100% Unrefined Cold Pressed
- Extracted without heat or chemical solvents
• Preserve Nutrients, Antioxidants & Natural Flavor
• Highly Stable & Resistant to Rancidity and Oxidation

3rd Party Lab-Verified Quality
How often do you find a cooking oil that is lab-tested with a Certificate of Analysis for every batch? Every batch of LABO Nutrition Camelina Oil is screened for quality, purity and freshness, so you know exactly what you are getting each time.

• Screened Across 30 Quality & Purity Markers
• Lab-Verified 100% Pure Camelina Profile  
• Individually Screened for 20+ Natural Fatty Acids
• Triple-Tested for Peak Freshness
• Triple-Screened Against Spoiling
• Lab-Proven Freshness That Beats Standard Limits 

Ingredient
100% Unrefined Virgin Camelina Oil

Nutrition Highlights Per 15ml
• Total Fat – 13.7g
 • Saturated Fat – 1.2g
 • Polyunsaturated Fat – 7.8g
 • Omega-3 – 5.3g
 • Omega-6 – 2.5g
 • Monounsaturated Fat – 4.4g
 • Omega-9 – 4.3g
 • Trans Fat – 0g
 • Vitamin E – 9.6mg
 • Plant Sterols – 78mg

Vitamin E & Plant Sterols
With 9.6mg Vitamin E per 15ml, our Camelina Oil provides antioxidant support while helping protect the oil from rancidity and harmful free radical formation. It also provides 78mg plant sterols per 15ml, which help support healthy cholesterol and beneficial Omega-3 levels in the body.

High Heat Stability with an Unrefined Process
Our Camelina Oil gives you something many cooking oils do not: a high 245°C smoke point while remaining unrefined. That means you can use it for high-heat cooking without relying on refined oil.

Unrefined Oils
 • Camelina Oil – 245°C
 • Extra Virgin Olive Oil – 160°C
 • Coconut Oil – 177°C
 • Grape Seed Oil – 216°C
 • Flaxseed Oil – 107°C

Refined Oils
 • Canola Oil – 204°C
 • Sunflower Oil – 227°C
 • Peanut Oil – 227°C
 • Palm Oil – 235°C
 • Safflower Oil – 266°C

So while some refined oils may also have high smoke points, our Camelina Oil stands out by combining high-heat cooking performance with an unrefined process.

Lower Saturated Fat for Everyday Meals
When you cook with our Camelina Oil, you can enjoy the same dishes with less saturated fat compared with selected other oils:
• Fried noodles / stir-fry: up to 4.4X lower saturated fat
• Fried rice: up to 4.3X lower saturated fat
• Fried spring rolls: up to 4X lower saturated fat

Product Quality
• Non-GMO
• Pesticide-Free
• Sustainably Cultivated
• Proven Freshness
• Internationally Approved Quality Standards
• Guaranteed 100% Pure Camelina Oil
• No “Old Oil” Smell
• Pure & Chemical-Free
• Trans Fat Free

Country of Origin
Made in Canada

Net Volume
500ml

Frequently Asked Question
What cooking oil is safe for deep frying without toxic fumes? 
Camelina oil has a high smoke point of 245°C, making it highly stable for deep frying. Heating regular oils past their smoke point produces harmful free radicals, but this unrefined oil remains safe and minimizes greasy buildup.

Does unrefined camelina oil change the taste of food? 
No, it features a delicate and subtle flavour that will not alter your dishes. This makes it an excellent all-purpose culinary oil for everything.

How long does cold-pressed camelina oil last? 
It is highly stable and resists rancidity due to its naturally rich Vitamin E content. This built-in antioxidant protects the oil from rapid oxidation, giving it a longer and more stable shelf life than many other unrefined cooking oils when stored in a cool, dry place.

Disclaimer
This product is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure or prevent any disease. If you are pregnant, nursing, or taking any medication, please consult your physician before consuming any supplements.

variants.title: Keto Slim Mo Konjac Noodles/Pasta/Rice/Rice Cake Ideal Food Staples - Ketoslim - Ketoslimo by Shears
variants.product_description:
Dear Customer, if you are looking for economy packs of ketoslimo dry rice in 500g and 1kg, please visit
https://shopee.sg/product/18723020/49610221504/

Konjac plant, or the root, is a Japanese root vegetable that is full of fiber. It has been used by people in East Asia for thousands of years and is mainly grown in Asian countries. Similar looking to an odd-shaped potato (as they come from the same family as potatoes), it contains a soluble fiber called glucomannan. In fact, it has the highest molecular weight and consistency as any known dietary fiber.

With so many health benefits, it’s no wonder that many people are looking for ways to add the konjac plant into their diet and beauty regime. With many foods now incorporating konjac into the ingredients list, such as Konjac Range, it’s now getting easier to enjoy the foods we love, all while gaining health and assisting with weight loss.
Our konjac product is a source of fiber and a low calorie, zero carbs, and gluten, wheat, fat, sugar, and salt-free alternative. Our foods are made from organic Konjac flour, from the root of an ancient Japanese organic plant called Konjac. Suitable for Coeliacs, Vegans, and Vegetarians, Konjac has been consumed in Japan for many centuries. On its own, it has a neutral taste but when added to healthy ingredients, the pasta absorbs the flavor so that you can enjoy a healthy and delicious meal.

Gluten, sugar & Fat-FREE
Wheat FREE
NO added artificial flavors
NO added  preservatives 
ZEROcarbs and LOWcalorie
Ready in 2 minutes

How to cook: Heat in an open pan for 1-2 minutes or in a microwave for 1 minute. Add to your favorite pasta sauce, stir-fry, soup, or salad. 
(Optional: Rinse 2-3 times under cold water before heating)

DIETARY FRIENDLY: Konjac Noodles and rice are approved for these special diets: Keto, Paleo, Certified Gluten-Free, Grain-Free, Soy-Free, Certified Vegan, Certified Kosher, and Blood Sugar-Friendly. Konjac Noodle products are made from quality, plant-based ingredients, and may not be suitable for people with sensitivities to high-fiber foods

FULL OF FLAVOR: Choose from 9 different noodle types and add your favorite flavor sauce and ready to be served
TAKE IT WITH YOU: You can easily enjoy Konjac Noodle at home or on the go!
ANCIENT RECIPE: Our noodles and rice are 95% water and 5%Konjac Flour --. It's the same way the Buddhist monks who developed these noodles made them over 1400 years ago!

Support Keto Diet!

Dear Customer, if you are looking for economy packs of ketoslimo dry rice in 500g and 1kg, please visit
https://shopee.sg/product/18723020/49610221504/

Konjac plant, or the root, is a Japanese root vegetable that is full of fiber. It has been used by people in East Asia for thousands of years and is mainly grown in Asian countries. Similar looking to an odd-shaped potato (as they come from the same family as potatoes), it contains a soluble fiber called glucomannan. In fact, it has the highest molecular weight and consistency as any known dietary fiber.

With so many health benefits, it’s no wonder that many people are looking for ways to add the konjac plant into their diet and beauty regime. With many foods now incorporating konjac into the ingredients list, such as Konjac Range, it’s now getting easier to enjoy the foods we love, all while gaining health and assisting with weight loss.
Our konjac product is a source of fiber and a low calorie, zero carbs, and gluten, wheat, fat, sugar, and salt-free alternative. Our foods are made from organic Konjac flour, from the root of an ancient Japanese organic plant called Konjac. Suitable for Coeliacs, Vegans, and Vegetarians, Konjac has been consumed in Japan for many centuries. On its own, it has a neutral taste but when added to healthy ingredients, the pasta absorbs the flavor so that you can enjoy a healthy and delicious meal.

Gluten, sugar & Fat-FREE
Wheat FREE
NO added artificial flavors
NO added  preservatives 
ZEROcarbs and LOWcalorie
Ready in 2 minutes

How to cook: Heat in an open pan for 1-2 minutes or in a microwave for 1 minute. Add to your favorite pasta sauce, stir-fry, soup, or salad. 
(Optional: Rinse 2-3 times under cold water before heating)

DIETARY FRIENDLY: Konjac Noodles and rice are approved for these special diets: Keto, Paleo, Certified Gluten-Free, Grain-Free, Soy-Free, Certified Vegan, Certified Kosher, and Blood Sugar-Friendly. Konjac Noodle products are made from quality, plant-based ingredients, and may not be suitable for people with sensitivities to high-fiber foods

FULL OF FLAVOR: Choose from 9 different noodle types and add your favorite flavor sauce and ready to be served
TAKE IT WITH YOU: You can easily enjoy Konjac Noodle at home or on the go!
ANCIENT RECIPE: Our noodles and rice are 95% water and 5%Konjac Flour --. It's the same way the Buddhist monks who developed these noodles made them over 1400 years ago!

Support Keto Diet!

variants.title: Haddrell's of Cambridge Manuka Honey UMF 10+ 1kg
variants.product_description:
The Haddrell’s Story
Haddrell's of Cambridge® is one of the longest standing producers of UMF™ Grade Manuka Honey. It was established in 1993 by Richard and Moira Haddrell with a great passion for honey and fifteen beehives. Cambridge is a small rural town in the centre of the lush dairy farming district of Waikato, in the North Island of New Zealand, ideally located close to the pristine hills where the unique Manuka Tree grows.
Haddrell's of Cambridge® UMF™ certified Manuka honey supports health and wellbeing. We guarantee the UMF™ rating of all our Manuka Honey by independently testing every batch by accredited scientific laboratories in New Zealand.
What is UMF? 
UMF™ is a quality trademark that grade Mānuka honey by measuring its Unique Mānuka Factors (UMF™) and certify it with a UMF™ number (from 5+ to 25+). (Read here for more information of the grading system)
In short, it assures purity and quality. Honey companies that use this grading system are official licensees of the UMF™ Honey Association (UMFHA), which has strict criteria and audits its members’ packaging and marketing material.
Both Nature’s Farm and Haddrell's of Cambridge® are members of the UMFHA
Rating of Manuka Honey:
UMF <10+ For health maintenance
UMF 10 - 14+ Ideal for better immunity and increased energy level
UMF = 15+ Superior levels with very high activity levels for therapeutic usageÂ for example sore throat.
Health Benefits:
Manuka Honey is a premium source of nutrient, and naturally rich in amino acids, vitamins & enzymes.
A higher rating of UMF® indicates a better quality of nutrients.
What is the difference between UMF & MGO?
UMF and MGO are two individual grading systems. UMF™ is a complete and advance grading system that measures:
MGO Levels
Additional testing of authenticity markers such as Leptosperin and Dihydroxyacetone (DHA)
Hydroxymethylfurfural (HMF) – Quality marker to guarantee the honey has not undergone excessive heating.
The MGO Manuka Honey grading system simply and directly reflects the MGO (methylglyoxal) content of the honey. An MGO rating is a standardised measure of methylglyoxal content and is an indicator of quality.
Both UMF and MGO grading systems are precise and reliable tests. However, there have been reported cases where artificial DHA and MGO has been added to increase the anti-bacterial properties.
As such, the UMF grading system is the best indicator for authenticity, purity and quality of Manuka Honey as compared to MGO
Ingredient list: Manuka Honey
Recommended dosage: Take 1 teaspoon 1-3 times daily (Do not feed to infants under 1)
Product of New Zealand

Matcha: It has a stronger buttery flavor and its green tea cream is smooth and not too sweet. Absolutely delicious and with every single bite, it will melt in your mouth. 

Milk Tea: Crispy, buttery cookies with smooth milk tea cream inside — light, fragrant, and perfectly sweet! 

Strawberry: A lighter, fruitier choice with refreshing strawberry cream that keeps every bite crisp and enjoyable. 

Sakura White Chocolate: Smooth, creamy white chocolate with the gentle floral aroma of sakura (cherry blossom) creates a lightly sweet flavour experience.

White Chocolate: Sweet, thin and crunchy biscuits sandwiched the sweet white chocolate filling. These tasty biscuits are ideal for enjoying by themselves at work or school, or with a cup of hot tea.

Ingredients:
Chocolate: Wheat flour (domestic production), quasi-chocolate, shortening, sugar, egg white, butter, starch syrup, milk, starch, egg, salt, cocoa/emulsifier, artificial flavor. Contains wheat, egg, dairy products and soybean.

Matcha: Wheat flour (domestic production), quasi-chocolate (sugar, vegetable oils and fats, lactose, whole milk powder, cocoa butter, matcha, skim milk powder), shortening, sugar, egg white, starch syrup, butter, milk, starch, matcha, salt/emulsifier, artificial flavor. Contains wheat, egg, dairy products and soybean.

White Chocolate: Wheat flour (domestic production), quasi-chocolate, shortening, sugar, egg white, butter, starch syrup, milk, starch, salt/emulsifier, flavor. Contains wheat, egg, dairy products and soybean.

Barley Grass Powder Contain:（3g×44sachets / per box )

Yamamoto Kanpoh’s barley grass uses juvenile shoots of barley grass abundant in nutrients.
On the farmland managed by the company, absorbing nutrients from the sun and the earth, the barley grass of "the highest nutritional value" slowly grows up, for 60 days, a period four times longer than usual, and only the first shoots that grow are harvested, only young leaves from the high-quality "first cutting" are used.
Committed to maintain a 100% additive-free product, we do not use any agricultural chemicals or chemical fertilizers. Naturally, flavourings and other chemicals are also not used, to the best of our ability we use safe and secure barley grass that only utilizes “the power of nature”.
The screening of the base ingredients is performed with great care and the sprouts- checked one by one, any plants and foreign bodies other than the barley grass and anything that interferes with the barley’s growth is removed.
Moreover, when importing, the chemical inspections are carried out by an external agency and by our own laboratory, we only use the ingredients that have passed the inspection. Manufacturing is carried out in our own factory in Aichi Prefecture, Japan.
We continuously challenge ourselves in order to improve the taste and quality of our product.

Yamamoto Kanpoh Barley Grass Powder is recommended for people who:
_ Do not eat enough vegetables.
_ Want to drink delicious barley grass juice.
_ Want to maintain good health
_ Do not like vegetables.
_ Want to supplement vegetable intake while on a diet.

 Ingredients
Yamamoto Kanpou Barley Grass Powder is 100% pure barley leaves (leaf) powder. Yamamoto Kanpou Barley Grass Powder is made from young barley leaves grown without the use of pesticides, and contains NO binders, sweeteners, fillers, or additives of any kind.

 DirectionsIn a shaker/glass, mix 3g (2 full scoops/ 1 pack) of Yamamoto Kanpou Barley Grass Powder with 4 oz. of water, milk, soymilk, or juice. Have 1-2 servings daily.

Marou Faiseurs de Chocolat is Vietnam’s first bean-to-bar chocolate maker, crafting bold, award-winning chocolate from 100% locally grown cacao.
